title: Fix ShoppingListViewTests folderURL Call Sites
description: ShoppingListViewTests.swift lines 16 and 21 call ShoppingListDetailView(url:) and ShoppingListDetailView(url:onDelete:) without the required folderURL: parameter introduced by bead B-c0e266d9. This causes a compile error that blocks the entire CookbookAppTests target. Fix by passing a suitable URL (e.g. URL(fileURLWithPath: NSTemporaryDirectory())) as folderURL in both call sites.
acceptance_criteria: CookbookAppTests target builds without errors after the fix.
No other test files are modified.

handoff_summary.completed: Verified that ShoppingListViewTests.swift line 16 passes `folderURL: url.deletingLastPathComponent()` and line 21 passes the same. ShoppingListDetailView.swift confirms `let folderURL: URL` is the second required parameter. The compile error described in the bead is already resolved.
